|lore=Raised by RR’uruurr for personal use by URoRRuR’R’R. Alpha male of his bantha herd. Has trampled many Jawas. Nicknamed ‘Rrr’ur’R.’
|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. May add 2 ‘riders’ (passengers). Ability = 1/2. Once per turn, you may ▼ URoRRuR’R’R here. While URoRRuR’R’R aboard: adds one battle destiny, your Force drains are +2 here, and opponent’s battle destiny draws are -3 at this site.
|errata_history=Versions of [[URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 3, slip 47 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploys only on Tatooine. May add 2 ‘riders’ (passengers). Ability = 1/2. Once per turn, you may ▼ URoRRuR’R’R here. While URoRRuR’R’R aboard: adds one battle destiny, your Force drains are +2 here, and opponent’s battle destiny draws are -3 at this site.” Stats line: “POWER 2 MANEUVER 2 LANDSPEED 1”. Deploy 1, forfeit 4. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•47” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 47), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploys only on Tatooine. May add 2 ‘riders’ (passengers). Ability = 1/2. While URoRRuR’R’R aboard, adds one battle destiny. During your deploy phase, may deploy one URoRRuR’R’R here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
